fields.description: Issue includes editorials and reader letters concerning the alleged beating of Charles Haynes by Miami police and calls for investigation by the grand jury; local political coverage and announcements ahead of upcoming elections; commentary on Miami High School disciplinary methods; discussion of Community Chest fundraising and proposed elimination of playground supervisors; civic/business editorials including criticism of a city resolution favoring American cement over imported cement and its implications for trade; local transportation and aviation notes (airport location at Gratigny; Clarence Chamberlain visit and flying exhibition in Coral Gables); plus society/entertainment items, arrivals, and advertisements for Miami and Miami Beach businesses.
